# arin_whois_customers (Data Source)

Search public Whois-RWS customers using one or more supported filters. References are returned by default; show_details requests full records. Typed fields and complete XML are retained. No API key is sent. Partial results and referrals are errors; recognized no-results responses produce an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_whois_customers" "example" {
  filters      = { "handle" : "C00000001" }
  show_details = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filters` (Map of String) Nonempty map of search predicates. Allowed keys: q, handle, name. q performs a general text search across handles and names. Predicates are combined with AND. Values match case-insensitively; a single trailing * requests a prefix match. Unknown keys, empty values and other wildcard positions are rejected locally.

### Optional

- `show_details` (Boolean) Ask ARIN to expand related information inline. Complete XML preserves extra records; any nested truncation is rejected. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `customers` (Attributes List) Matching records ordered deterministically. Reference responses omit detail-only fields; show_details requests full records. Recognized no-results responses produce an empty list. Truncation is an error. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customers))
- `whois_xml` (String) Complete search response XML. Null for a recognized Whois no-results HTTP 404. Links are not followed.

<a id="nestedatt--customers"></a>

- `state` (String) state returned by ARIN.
- `street_address` (List of String) Ordered lines of street address.
- `update_date` (String) update date returned by ARIN.
